title: 2024 budget process and lobbyist registry deferral
subtitle: Administrative penalties program, strategic planning update, and development charges sustainability report were also handled on the consent agenda.
overview: The Administration and Finance Committee reviewed the process for the Region's 2024 Plan and Budget. Staff said the main pressures are lingering high inflation, capital project costs and uncertainty about provincial funding, along with the cost of serving a fast-growing population. The committee referred the budget process report back to staff for changes discussed at the meeting, to return to Council on June 21, 2023 {{vote:m7}}.

The committee recommended deferring consideration of a lobbyist registry to the 2024 Plan and Budget {{vote:m5}}. The staff report includes a draft by-law and code of conduct, which will be open for further discussion at that time.

Through the consent agenda, the committee also dealt with an administrative penalties program, a strategic planning update for 2023-2027, and a report on the sustainability of Regional development charges {{vote:m1}}. There were no delegations or presentations from the public.

decisions.item: 2024 Plan and Budget Process and Guidelines
decisions.detail: The committee referred the report back to staff for changes discussed at the meeting, to return to Council on June 21, 2023 {{vote:m7}}.
The committee recommended that Council defer consideration of a lobbyist registry to the 2024 Plan and Budget {{vote:m5}}.
The committee approved the consent agenda recommendation on implementing an administrative penalties program.
The committee received the strategic planning update for information.
The committee received the report on development charges sustainability for information.
